name: Bramble
description: Two rings of thorns grown out of one stem, the outer set turned off the inner so no spike hides behind another: what the find does to the barbs on your back and the hairs on your skin is the same thing twice, and a single crown of thorns would have said it once. Moss green for the growth, with a blood bead at the centre where the stem is — the barbs are the body's, and they cost the body. Legibility pass: the thorn rings sat at moss's own value, which on this plate is the plate. Both rings went a step up — the outer to `$moss.light`, the inner past it — so the crown reads as growth catching light rather than as a dark star on a dark panel.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
